    Resolve the publication stamp from scaffold provenance

    quartoRenderStamp.Rd

    Aggregates the per-file revisions recorded in a project manifest and checks those files against their recorded MD5 digests. The stamp describes all registered scaffolds, not only the files used by one rendered artifact. Missing or modified files, dirty revisions and unknown provenance mark the result as a draft. This function reads files without changing them.

    Usage

    quartoRenderStamp(manifest, root = getwd())

    Arguments

    manifest

    Parsed project manifest as a list. An empty list represents a project without recorded scaffold provenance.

    root

    Project directory containing the recorded relative file paths. Defaults to the current working directory.

    Value

    A character scalar with the publication date, sorted abbreviated revisions and, when applicable, a DRAFT marker. The current local time supplies the date and is also reported through a message condition.
